rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for handing something or someone over to another person’s care or control.

example.english: I’ll consign this cat to your care for now.
example.traditional: 呢隻貓暫時交畀你照顧啦。
example.jyutping: ne1 zek3 maau1 zaam6 si4 gaau1 bei2 nei5 ziu3 gu3 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is sending something on to its final destination.

example.english: We need to consign this shipment to the warehouse today.
example.traditional: 呢批貨今日要送去倉庫。
example.jyutping: ne1 pai1 fo3 gam1 jat6 jiu3 sung3 heoi3 cong1 fu3

rows.note: Use this specifically when goods are placed with a seller to be sold on the owner’s behalf.

example.english: I’ll consign a few old clothes to a second-hand shop.
example.traditional: 我將幾件舊衫寄賣畀間二手店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 gei2 gin6 gau6 saam1 gei3 maai6 bei2 gaan1 ji6 sau2 dim3
